mentions.name: Banquish
mentions.description: A web app that lets users and AI agents put exact pieces from any websites they need onto a single screen. The pieces are live and interactive like normal web browser content rather than static screenshots.
mentions.problem: Created to avoid having to switch between and refresh a bunch of browser tabs.
mentions.source_excerpt:
working on an app which you/agents can put exact pieces from any websites you need into a one screen.(https://banquish.space)

I didn't want to switch/refresh bunch of tabs. That's why I made this one.

not screenshots. so you can still interact with the pieces like in normal web browsers.
